title: Osanwe staged-order artifact (TENFOLD T11 action staircase)
description: The JSON shape an equity order MUST take to be eligible for the pre-trade gate. Options are NOT representable here (asset_class is const 'equity'); option orders remain denied at the permission layer. In production the main loop composes this artifact, runs tools/pretrade_gate.py over it (which reads a live book snapshot), and only a PASS yields a signed gate-pass that the PreToolUse token hook will honor -- and only after the human types 'EXECUTE ORDER <order_id>' in a genuine prompt.

order_id.description: Unique nonce for this order. Anti-replay key; the human names it in the confirm phrase. One order_id is consumed exactly once.

created_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of staging. Feeds pass TTL context.

symbol.description: Equity ticker (upper-cased for the canonical hash).

asset_class.description: MUST be 'equity'. The staircase never carries options; option-order tools stay denied.

limit_price.description: Required (> 0) when order_type == 'limit'; null/absent for market.

estimated_notional.description: ADVISORY declared size. The gate does NOT trust this for concentration: it sizes off quantity x a TRUSTED book price and BLOCKS if this declared value diverges more than 5% from quantity*price (round-1 A2 fix). Must be finite (NaN/Infinity rejected).

thesis.description: Thesis bucket for concentration (e.g., theme-alpha, theme-gamma, theme-beta, broad). For a symbol KNOWN to the book (held, or in book.thesis_map) the book's label is AUTHORITATIVE and a mismatch is BLOCKED as a mislabel (round-1 A2 fix); the declared value is only used for a symbol the book does not know.

risk_reward.description: Reward/risk ratio. BUY orders must clear the 3:1 hurdle.

sleep_gate_ack.description: Rested-state attestation. BUY requires true; the gate also blocks all BUYs while the sleep-gate sentinel is active.

book_snapshot.description: Inline book snapshot OR a path string. Shape: {as_of_utc, total_value, positions:[{symbol,thesis,value}], prices:{SYMBOL:price}, thesis_map:{SYMBOL:thesis}}. The main loop populates it from the read-only broker MCP (get_equity_positions/get_portfolio for positions+total; get_equity_quotes for prices). prices MUST cover the order symbol (else the gate BLOCKs) because concentration is sized off quantity x this trusted price, NOT the order's declared notional. thesis_map lets the book assert a thesis for symbols not currently held. Numbers must be finite; as_of_utc within 24h. Treated as TRUSTED (broker-sourced); a forged snapshot is a vault-write-compromise threat, out of the gate's mechanical scope and mitigated by human review + the positions-vs-total consistency check.
